_how: Coded by eye from strips/<slug>.jpg (9 frames) and strips/dense/dense_NN.jpg (every 0.2 s, 0-5 s). cuts = verified framing changes by cut or dissolve in 0-5 s (snap pushes and continuous follows are not counted). face/eyes at frame 0: Y = face visible / eyes to camera; side = 3/4 or profile, looking off; N = no face. act0 = the hook sentence's odd act is visible in frame 0 (Y / part / N). opp3 = time a second character or opposing force is first on screen (null = not by 5 s). recog = topic built on an everyday thing most viewers already know (Y / med / N). type = first sentence type.
